name: on-the-lesson

lesson.title: What a queue is
say: A queue holds work until a worker is free.
The sender never waits on the receiver.
explain: A burst piles up in the queue, not on the worker.

question: Why does a queue help with bursts?

good.answer:
A queue takes the burst so the worker never drowns.
Work waits in line until a worker is free.
The sender moves on at once.

question: What is a cache?

good.answer:
A cache keeps a copy close so the next read is fast.
It trades freshness for speed.
The pack covers this in the cache lesson.
